name: Jamaican Dominoes
description: Jamaican dominoes: Caribbean draw game. Four players; partner or cut-throat (no partner). Double-six.

overview.description: Jamaican dominoes: Caribbean draw game. Four players; partner or cut-throat (no partner). Double-six.

history.origins: Domino games are enthusiastically played across the Caribbean; in Jamaica the style is boisterous and pieces are often slammed on the table. Two main forms are played: Partner (fixed partnerships, favoured in world tournaments) and Cut Throat (each player for himself), with contributions documented from JamDom.com and local players.
timeline: 20th century: Caribbean dominoes played in Jamaica; partner and cut-throat styles documented.

setup.players: Four players for Partner or Cut Throat; partners sit opposite at a square table.
setup.deck: Double-six domino set of 28 tiles (0-0 through 6-6), known as bones.
setup.dealing: Each player receives 7 bones; in Cut Throat with 4 players each gets 7; remaining tiles form the boneyard.

rules.objective: In Partner: your team aims to win 6 points while the opponents have 0 (six love). In Cut Throat: be first to 6 wins provided another player has 0. Win a hand by playing all your bones or by having fewest spots when the game is blocked.
rules.gameplay: Play is anti-clockwise. Each turn a player plays one bone to extend one of the two ends of the layout; touching ends must match. Doubles are played at right angles. If a player cannot play they pass (no draw in standard block style for Partner; Cut Throat follows same play). The hand ends when one player empties their hand or the game blocks. Winning team scores 1 point; playing the key bone (only playable bone when both ends are hard) scores 2.

variations.name: Partner
variations.description: Four players in fixed partnerships; first to 6 points (opponents 0) wins.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Variant uses same engine; no numeric overrides needed.

variations.name: Cut Throat
variations.description: Each player for himself; first to 6 wins provided another has 0.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Variant uses same engine; partnership flag differs in play only.

scoring.description: Caribbean draw dominoes. Points scored per hand. Target 100+ points wins.
scoring.winCondition: First to target score or only player remaining.

synthesis.shortDescription: A Caribbean domino draw game with partner and cut-throat variations, popular in Jamaica.
